_what: The signed-in workspace's settings, as DATA: its lists, its addresses and what opens at start. Its screens are Workshop rows (records/workshop-screen-tool-records.json, each row's screen.surface), read together with these settings through src/workspace/screens.mjs, which every module imports. The sidebar lists them, the screen arrangement holds them in tabs and panes, and src/workspace/main.tsx mounts each by its package_entry.entry_name. A screen's glance (what its hover card reads, as paths into its source) and actions (window events the page listens for) fill the sidebar's hover card. A screen's opens_kinds are the kinds of thing it opens one of (a mention of a decision opens the decision screen on it, src/workspace/mentions.ts). A screen's route_paths are its own addresses: the workspace opens there with that screen. A screen's route_prefix opens it for every address under that prefix, with the rest of the address as its route_input (one decision per tab); listed:false keeps it out of every list, since it only opens for one thing. A screen naming an audience is offered only to a viewer holding it. A collection's icon is what a collapsed rail shows for it. The sidebar's switches are DATA at three levels, narrower winning (parts/sidebar/read-data/sidebar-settings.ts): a collection's settings for its list, a screen's sidebar_settings for its row (remove_from_list:false keeps Plan in its list; move_between_lists:false keeps it from being dragged into another). A collection named in sidebar_content_host_by_section_id hosts a shared panel instead of rows (the arrangement's pane map). sidebar_header_content_host names the shared panel at the top of the sidebar, above every list: the workspace's focus (src/workspace/scope-focus.ts), which names what the whole workspace is about and switches it. Addresses are resolved in one place, src/workspace/addresses.mjs: home_path opens the workspace on its starting screens; an address under one of moved_from is an old address, answered with a permanent redirect to the same address without that prefix when that opens a screen; a screen with signed_out_visitor "public-page" shares its address with a page for people who are not signed in (the sign-in page), and every other screen address signs a visitor in and brings them back. An address that is, or is one step under, a `from` of signed_in_moved opens, for someone signed in, the same address under its `to` (/community/<id> is the pursuit at /spaces/<id>); it moves only for someone signed in, since a visitor who is not signed in keeps the public page answered there (a community's open page), and the bare `from` signs them in and brings them to `to`. A list may hold rows by a rule (`holds.rules`, the formula engine's rule tree) and show only while its own rule holds (`shown_when`); the rules name the facts `sidebar_row_facts` declares, each reading a path of the row or of one of the person's records kept by row id (`from`, an inputs.json name: `sidebar-seen` when a row was first offered to them, `sidebar-notes` the notes their AI left), and measured against now when it has a `time` (days_since or days_until). A list whose settings say `repeats_rows` (New) shows rows that also sit in their own lists. A surface row's `sidebar_new_until` (a date, a tool's screen.new_until) keeps it in New until then, and its `listed_on` (when it was added to Trillion, each tool row's own) orders New newest first (`order_by`, a path and descending). A fact with `clock` is now itself (a rule Today is before a date shows until that date); `on` says whether a fact describes rows, lists or both, which is what a person's list menu offers. The person's own lists and their rows carry the same rules (made through change_sidebar or a list's When it shows), kept in their own list records and decided the same way (parts/sidebar/read-data/apply-list-rules.ts). A list's `row_chip` ({ label, variant: a shared Badge variant }) marks each row it holds with that chip wherever else the row is drawn (New's rows say New in their own lists).

surfaces.label: Settings
surfaces.description: Manage your account, connected accounts and workspace in one place.

surfaces.label: Home
surfaces.description: Where things stand: what is waiting for your answer, your numbers over time, recent decisions, your goals and what your AIs did.

surfaces.label: Menu bar
surfaces.description: Trillion at a glance from your Mac's menu bar: your next step, what your AIs are doing, what waits for you and what came in, answered right there.

surfaces.label: Screens together
surfaces.description: Several screens arranged as one: placed with its own arrangement, it shows those screens side by side or stacked, each kept as you arrange it.

surfaces.label: Greeting and next step

surfaces.label: Time to decide
surfaces.description: Each point is one of your decisions, oldest on the left.

surfaces.label: Waiting on you
surfaces.description: Everything only you can do, one thing at a time until none is left: why it needs you, what it unlocks, and the one way to finish it.

surfaces.label: Waiting for you
surfaces.description: Only you can say how these went. Hover one to answer.

surfaces.label: Notifications
surfaces.description: What happened for you: invitations, new things in your pursuits and your AIs' work.

surfaces.label: Message your AIs
surfaces.description: Write once to every AI, or to the ones you @mention, a pursuit or an action, with files, links, your voice, your screen or a drawing. It floats over your work; Cmd+Shift+Pursuit opens and closes it from anywhere.

surfaces.label: Your tray
surfaces.description: Things you picked anywhere in Trillion, ready to send to an AI, a pursuit or the people who make Trillion.

surfaces.label: Your devices
surfaces.description: Whether every copy of your things is in step: working offline, changes waiting, each device catching up, and anything two devices changed apart, kept as two versions until you choose.

surfaces.label: In step
surfaces.description: Whether every copy of your things is in step: working offline, changes waiting, catching up, or all caught up. Pressed, it shows your devices.

surfaces.label: Two versions
surfaces.description: Everything two of your devices changed apart, kept as two versions, to settle by picking one, keeping both or keeping your picks field by field.

surfaces.label: Write
surfaces.description: Write pages: headings, lists, tables and blocks you move, kept as your own pages.

surfaces.label: Record
surfaces.description: Record a voice memo and read your words as you say them; it goes to your Files and your AI.

surfaces.label: Record audio
surfaces.description: Record your voice with a live waveform, pause and pick up again, or bring in an audio file; every recording is kept in a list you can rename and sort, and goes to your Files and your AI.

surfaces.label: Record video
surfaces.description: Record a video or your voice, read a script from Formats as it scrolls with your words, and keep every take in a list; each goes to your Files and your AI.

surfaces.label: Always recording
surfaces.description: Every camera and microphone you connect records without end once you press Start: a camera over USB, your phone, your computer. Pieces line up by time, go to your Files as they are recorded, and reach your AI.

surfaces.label: Formats
surfaces.description: Shape something you have said into a format for recording or publishing.

surfaces.label: Files
surfaces.description: Every file and folder in your Trillion space.

surfaces.label: Media

surfaces.label: File
surfaces.description: One of your files, opened: a video or sound plays, and a picture, PDF, text, code or Office document shows.

surfaces.label: Media edit
surfaces.description: Play and review the clips selected from Media.

surfaces.label: Messages

surfaces.label: Network
surfaces.description: Find people and connect with them.

surfaces.label: All pursuits

surfaces.label: Progress

surfaces.label: Apply

surfaces.label: Clients
surfaces.description: Applications to your program, and every decision your clients share with you.

surfaces.description: Add Trillion to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor or any AI app, and the jobs to ask for.

surfaces.label: Tours
surfaces.description: Short guided tours of each part of Trillion, to take again any time.

surfaces.label: Waiting tours
surfaces.description: The tours waiting to show you, why there are more of them, and when the next one shows: show one now, dismiss it, pause it, or change when they show.

surfaces.label: Connections
surfaces.description: The services Trillion works with, and how to connect each one.

surfaces.label: Sharing
surfaces.description: Where a share from your phone or browser can go, and what your AI does with it.

surfaces.label: Notification settings

surfaces.label: Plan
surfaces.description: The plans Trillion offers, the one you are on and what is left this month.

surfaces.label: Billing
surfaces.description: Who you pay for, the card each purchase uses, what each part of your deal costs and your usage day by day.

surfaces.label: Account & security
surfaces.description: Your name, passkeys and other ways to sign in, where you are signed in, and deleting your account.

surfaces.label: Invite friends
surfaces.description: Your link to invite people, who joined with it and what it earned you.

surfaces.label: Look
surfaces.description: How Trillion looks and how its panes size and snap.

surfaces.label: Privacy
surfaces.description: Whether your decisions teach other people, anonymously, and the stories published from them.

surfaces.label: AI apps & keys

surfaces.label: Business
surfaces.description: Paid plans on your Stripe account and how people use Trillion.

surfaces.label: Automations
surfaces.description: Everything your Trillion does by itself: triggers, schedules and workflows, each with a switch to turn it on or off.

surfaces.label: Funnels

surfaces.description: One funnel, stage by stage.

surfaces.description: Lay a tour, a screen, and anything else editable, out as all its parts on the canvas, change any words or look in place, and choose whether the change is for this one, this whole thing or every one like it.

surfaces.label: Lists
surfaces.description: Your lists: people, customers, the AIs in a pursuit, anything kept in rows and columns.

surfaces.label: Calendar
surfaces.description: One calendar of everything with a time: meetings in every pursuit you are in, your posts and your Google Calendar. Switched to a pursuit, it is that pursuit's calendar, the same one everyone in it sees, with each other's cursors.

surfaces.label: Calendar
surfaces.description: Calendar events and scheduled tasks.

surfaces.label: Tasks
surfaces.description: Your existing tasks alongside the calendar.

surfaces.label: Calendar settings
surfaces.description: Calendar sources, preferences and meeting recording.

surfaces.label: Controls
surfaces.description: A few live controls an AI made for one thing you want to adjust yourself: a preview that changes as you move them, Undo, and a full copy kept when it looks right.

surfaces.label: List
surfaces.description: One list, row by row.

surfaces.label: Runs
surfaces.description: Every run of a tool your AI started: how it ended, what it was for and what it made. Tools themselves are found in the Marketplace.

surfaces.label: Marketplace
surfaces.description: Everything your AI can use, yours and everyone's: tools that do one job, workflows of several steps, screens, looks and setups. Publish yours for everyone, or take it back.

surfaces.label: Tool
surfaces.description: One tool: what it does, what it needs, how its runs went and your runs of it.

surfaces.label: Run
surfaces.description: One run of a tool: how it ended, what it returned and the files it made.

surfaces.label: Sites
surfaces.description: Import a built site, edit its pages, publish or restore versions, and see visits and responses.

surfaces.label: Tool
surfaces.description: A tool's own screen: what it does, what to give it, and what it returned.

surfaces.label: Draw

surfaces.label: Ambience

surfaces.label: Screen look over the day
surfaces.description: Turn on a plan for your screen look through the day: start from Evening dims to black, Follow the sun or Only late at night, or set your own times and looks. Between two points the screen moves gradually from one look to the next, on each of your devices in its own time zone. Hold the look you have any time, or let the plan carry on.

surfaces.label: Mail
surfaces.description: Search and read your Gmail, manage messages and drafts, reply, and turn an email into a task.
